summary: Mobile responsiveness (390x844) verified end-to-end + desktop regression (1920x800). All 4 reported bugs are fixed: (1) no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=391 vs innerWidth=390, top and bottom), (2) hamburger nav-toggle-btn visible at top-right and opens dark slide-in panel with all 9 nav links; close-X spans render cream rgb(243,241,234) when .open; (3) footer .footer-inner is flex-direction:column, align-items:center, both lines center-aligned and wrap normally; (4) all 62 .reveal elements gain .in after scroll (0/62 -> 62/62). Menu closes after clicking a link. Desktop unchanged: hamburger hidden, 9 links inline, footer row layout.
critical_code_review_comments: scrollWidth is 391 vs 390 innerWidth (1px, within tolerance) — likely a sub-pixel rounding from a border/shadow; not user-visible but could be tightened if desired.
62 .reveal elements start with opacity:0; if JS fails to load the whole page would be blank. The window 'load' safety fallback mitigates this — good defensive design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport MUST be set AFTER page.goto for it to apply. Use 390x844. All 4 reported mobile bugs verified fixed on preview URL. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/mobile_menu_open.png and mobile_footer.png.
